definitions.short: something protracted or flattened out , i.e. a platter
definitions.full: H6745. tselachah [ צֵלָחָה ] noun [feminine] pot for cooking ; — plural צֵלָחוֺת 2Chr 35:13 (+ דְּוָדִים מִירוֺת, ).

occurrences.englishText: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.
